notes.title: Summer Developer Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/cc06ed92de0c2d7431d3abd3d465f80f5e22d6e3.png[/img][h2]Hey there! This is the Summer Developer Update![/h2][p]
[i]Hope you guys are enjoying the summer season!
In this post we will be providing a general update on the current development progress of the game, what's to come and our plans on our road to 1.0!

Before we dive in, just a quick heads-up: everything you’re about to see is still a [b]work in progress[/b] and subject to change. [b]As for the next update no confirmed ETA just yet[/b], but we’ll be sure to let you know as soon as we have one. In the meantime, feel free to [url=https://discord.gg/2fbDGEGpH2]join our Discord[/url] to stay in the loop and chat with the dev team![/i]
[/p][h3]Here are the key topics covered in this post:[/h3][olist][*][p] General Developer Update[/p][/*][*][p] Main game updates[/p][/*][*][p] Campaign Remake - Development Progression & Teasers[/p][/*][*][p] Roadmap & Plans[/p][/*][*][p] FAQ
[/p][/*][/olist][p][h2]Developer Update[/h2]
Since the game’s last update, we’ve fully shifted our focus to developing the Campaign remake.
While it’s a massive undertaking, we haven’t slowed down one bit. In fact, we’ve doubled down. We’re adding more content, new power-ups ([b]A LOT.[/b]), tons of features, and a wave of updates to the AI, goalies, and much more.

The reworked campaign is currently being tested by a small group of players, and we’re keeping a close eye on their feedback, tweaking, experimenting, and having a blast in the process. We’re gradually expanding the testing group and will continue doing so until we’re ready to open it up for everyone to try out. [b]We do not have a set ETA until launch[/b]. 
If you are interested in becoming a tester, you can [url=https://discord.gg/2fbDGEGpH2]join our Discord[/url]!

[h2]Main game updates[/h2]
As mentioned before, a lot of new content is being added to the game.
Because of how extensive these changes are, we’ve decided to [b]pause updates to the main game for now and fully focus our development efforts on the campaign rework[/b]. However, the Alpha version of the Campaign Rework will be available to all [b]soon[/b]!

The features we’re working on are all interconnected, and updating just one part of the game in isolation would be trickier and less efficient. Instead, we’re aiming to deliver one big update down the line, one that will not only overhaul the campaign but enhance the entire game experience.

[h2]Campaign Remake - Development Progression & Teasers[/h2]

This campaign remake doesn’t just revamp the campaign, it transforms the entire game. With over 50 new power-ups added on top of the existing ones (some of which have been rebalanced or redesigned), chaos is guaranteed. 

Campaign 2.0 is a complete overhaul of the original campaign in Tape to Tape, with a ton of new features, power-ups, teams, and overall variety. Here's what you can expect:
[list]
[*] A full rework of core systems, including major changes in and outside of matches (events, node structures, pathing, and progression)
[*] Removal of the shop and puck currency system
[*] Rework of the legacy Elite and Power-Up unlocking systems
[*] Introduction of new Squads with unique playstyles to start your runs
[*] More Elite Teams and Bosses
[*] A wide variety of new Relics, Power-Ups, and Upgrades
[*] Additional node types across the world map & more paths
[*] Introduction of injuries, Free Agents, and more control over your lineup and bench
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/ea5ac166ed245da333a6a312cfda649ee5d3603a.gif[/img]
[i]Out with the old, in with the new.[/i]

[h3]Here's a breakdown of the changes coming in the Campaign Remake:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/7cbccfcd1aef337f3af0b15d57e63d5ebdfa76d7.png[/img]
[h3]Squads[/h3]
Squads act as your starting loadout when beginning a new run. Think of them as pre-built squads, each designed around a distinct gameplay style or strategy. While they provide a unique foundation, your decisions throughout the run will shape how the team evolves and adapts. Completing a run with a Squad will unlock new ones, each offering fresh gameplay twists and challenges to explore. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/0f174fd041de587e78e7dd1056a5e5c34a60383e.png[/img][h3]Injuries, Bench & Player Management[/h3]
[b]Injuries are now a thing in Tape to Tape![/b]
From impaired vision affecting shot accuracy, to shoulder damage weakening bodychecks, hand injuries reducing shot power, or banged-up feet slowing your skaters down, injuring the opposition has never been more strategic (or satisfying.. right?). But be warned, when your players get hurt, you may need to find replacements until they’re back in shape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/72ff23ba816ec057374c1142ec0427bb245b18bb.png[/img]
Even if a player isn’t injured, you might still want to swap them out. Whether it’s to strengthen your long-term roster or to capitalize on a short-term powerhouse who brings a burst of elite performance for just a few games. That said, landing on an Injury node to patch up one of your own can still be a game-changer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/1c91ec57c6f9191c46679d6b240a4494d7f59572.gif[/img]

Rotating your bench between games can also be a smart move, especially when you need specific attributes to counter the strengths of upcoming opponents. Strategic substitutions could be the key to victory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/3062be75c2ca8a380e442a83b819fba5a58086e8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/5b63bad6bbeb615752a4e71bfcd0b0bb36aceec7.png[/img][h3]New Nodes[/h3]
So long, Event Node and say hello to a whole new set of nodes on your path to glory!
The world map has also been reworked, now featuring multiple path options that give you more meaningful choices as you progress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/1f1ee7bafabc9d796256b6930ff298a8e9cc19d2.jpg[/img][i]WIP World Map[/i]

[b]Here are some of the new nodes you will encounter[/b] ([i]more information to follow when the update drops.[/i]):

[quote][b]Blademaster[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/f9a789565919074a913b08a318d4a8db49c63b70.png[/img]

[b]Coach's Corner[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/19fba0401f97873b28233f127b6fef667353ced0.png[/img]

[b]Infirmary[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/8f3201f7aeffd925a9b0ddfd0340b9c043c9179e.png[/img]

[b]General Manager[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/57c49bb6f69d727250877f34de78c4e2cb5708b6.png[/img]

[b]Training Center[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/78e0e3e75002f1cf33384dd290c06f32fc22a538.png[/img]

[b]Fan #1[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/6cb4c9ce142a84684107e8ac59dab9d7208dbc2d.png[/img]

[b]Chaos[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/843df6658153e5f722a104e075a698adeabc60dc.png[/img]
[/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/a7e16cfa1d60678a50e09b36af6db7375751a3da.png[/img]
[h3]New Power-ups[/h3]
With all the new stuff being added, of course power-ups are part of the package! We’ve been working on over [b]50 new power-ups[/b] ([i]and we're not done yet.[/i]), along with reworks and balance changes to the existing ones.

Finding fun and creative power-up synergies has always been one of our goals with Tape to Tape, and we’re super excited to see how the new additions will open up even more ways to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/489202660ae6445bf2a9e3bf5914bcdf3c057bbc.gif[/img]
[i]A little mix of farts and shots? Why not.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/5ac131412bc677a5cc977a9fb7066bb212e9fa0f.jpg[/img]

While some of the new power-ups are more on the fun and goofy side, they still serve a purpose and can come in handy. Others, though, might be a bit rarer but they’ll pack a much bigger punch when it comes to impact and rewards! We haven't forgotten about goalies, they are getting their fair share of power-ups too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/359ab5ecbd3f37310146dc3aa3c32b702c2ba82f.gif[/img]

[h3]Roadmap & Plans[/h3]
This time, we won’t be including our usual roadmap preview.
That’s because we’re working on many interconnected features at once, making it harder to lay out a clear timeline or order of what's coming next.

Instead, moving forward, we'll share teasers of what’s actually coming in the next patches.
This approach should help reduce confusion and set clearer expectations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/35621adcb18f58b09deaab5f8111b5197467aa38.gif[/img]
[i]This new power-up ties into an upcoming Elite Team. Can you guess what the power-up is and which team it's for?[/i]

[h3]Frequently Asked Questions[/h3]
[b]Q: When is the next update?[/b]
A: No ETA at this time. [url=https://discord.gg/2fbDGEGpH2]Join our Discord[/url] to stay in touch with the team!

[b]Q: Can I test the new campaign?[/b]
A: You sure can. Once we open applications on Discord, you’ll be able to apply!

[b]Q: Is Online coming?[/b]
A: Nope. Online is not planned for Tape to Tape at this time due to the game’s structure. In short, it would require a complete rebuild from the ground up to work properly online. However, [b]Steam Remote Play[/b] is still an option to play with your friends!

[b]Q: Are there more customization options in the works?[/b]
A: Yes! Lots of new stuff is coming down the line.

[b]Q: Franchise mode? Extra modes?[/b]
A: No Franchise mode planned for Tape to Tape. That said, we [i][b]might[/b][/i] add extra modes much later after the official release.

[b]Q: Is Butcher going to get better?[/b]
A: We're cooking up goalie power-ups as we speak. He’s on the right path. Don’t worry.

[b]Got more questions? Post them below and we’ll be happy to answer![/b]

[h3]That’s all for now![/h3]
We hope you enjoyed this Summer Development Update. We’re incredibly excited to share more of the campaign remake, and even more excited to get more people involved in testing!

As always, thank you for your continued support and passion for the game.

Stay tuned!

[b]The Tape To Tape Team[/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/ccdd411310ae374dfa495a457084bf16e92b100a.png[/img]
[b][h1] Hello everyone, this is Patch Notes 0.1.17! [/h1][/b]
[h3][b]Here are the key topics covered in this patch:[/b][/h3]
[*] Gameplay updates
[*] We need your help!
[*] Roguelite Campaign 2.0 Open Testing
[*] Roadmap Update & Teasers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/1158ee5a0339f538c5a88d0efea673d9f1ff3493.png[/img][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[*] Improvements made to the AI in the defensive zone
[quote=author]Changes were made to AI positioning and puck pursuit in various situations. This should also help reduce occasional clutter in front of the net[/quote][*] Curve ball talent now gives the player a curved hockey stick

([i]the football... the soccer ball... sigh[/i])
[*] Removed the wall of players in front of the net
[*] Increased the net size
[quote=author]The wall felt like it created too much clutter, was too easy to bypass, and restricted valuable shooting space. The Hockey FC team may receive another round of updates in the future. We’d love to hear your ideas on how to improve the foothockey experience! [/quote][h3][b]Crusaders[/b][/h3]
[*] The Jerseys now displays Roman numerals
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/418b4e28ad7148ccc776ad09fa3618b83834abf2.png[/img]
[*] Fixed major issue that guaranteed goals at extremely steep angles
[quote=author] Yep! We're sorry to say that this bug has been around for a little while. This fix should help reduce some of the soft goals that goalies would normally allow. Apologies for any broken controllers, keyboards, other hardware...[/quote][*] Fixed Keybind UI navigation with controller/keyboard
[*] Player sprite updates and corrections
[*] Several minor animation corrections
[*] Fixed a bug where players would have bright red arms and a glitched logo when using the Spiked Armor power-up
[*] Fixed some of the aura's VFX
[*] Fixed a bug where the raining meatballs would become gigantic ([i]YUGE[/i]) after a player scored a hat trick
[quote=author][i]This isn't Photoshopped...[/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/84a25392406d31bcff6525e3d13a0221670d5dab.jpg[/img][/quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/a7f368657e241551a9caca270e8e7a7b22c9ed29.png[/img]
[*] Fixed an issue where some matches in tournament series were not being recorded
[*] Fixed background UI being selected upon returning from a match
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/c601c1c231af1149ceedb1f60847a39ebc575b5c.png[/img]
[*] Fixed an issue where team colors were not saving properly
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would crash in the Team Editor after replacing a team's pre-built skater with a custom skater

[h1]In Other News...[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/56d7bdd0aa76cdfa3a7ed7d9d97e6c7d52f511cd.png[/img]

Well, first little spoiler: There will be Free Agents in Campaign 2.0. With that said, we need you to give us your best name ideas! Here are the instructions and restrictions:
[*] Has to be related to Hockey [i](can be a mix of Hockey and Golf/Soccer. MAY accept a mix of hockey and other sports.)[/i]
[*] Can be somewhat PG. Racism, homophobia, or discrimination will not be tolerated
[*] Must be posted in the comments of these patch notes

[b]Looking forward to having a good laugh reading the names![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/f07ef9466bb732cb6dee5e7628f1794b54ba28de.png[/img]
We are happy to announce that we are getting very close to a [b]playable Alpha Version of Campaign 2.0![/b] This time, however, it will not require you to join our Discord to become a tester. We will simply make an experimental testing branch available to all directly on Steam.

Your feedback has always been impactful on the development of Tape to Tape, and it will be essential as we rework the Campaign. While the main game’s updates may be smaller for some time, we will keep updating the testing branch and adding new content regularly.

[b]More information to come in the NEXT PATCH. We are very excited for you to give it a try and share your feedback and ideas![/b]
[quote=author][b][i]Here's a couple of new nodes you will be encountering during your runs![/i][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/58390ec6a60a85e54cec9ef5dd00f9ba40916c04.png[/img][/quote]

[h1]Roadmap Update & Teasers[/h1]
While some progress has been made on a few parts of the Roadmap, most of the focus was on the Campaign 2.0. However, we did progress on...

[h1]Fighting[/h1]

Originally, we took a very "vanilla" approach to fights, but then we realized... farts could be a lethal weapon once the gloves come off. With that said, expect more power-ups to gain a lot more potential, now that they can be used against your dance partner!

We're getting closer to a testable version of the fights as we continue to bring more of our ideas to life.

[b]Expect chaos.[/b]
[quote=author][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/056cc3e5edc15aa4d5b617fcdccf05c0138cb87f.png[/img][/quote]
[h1]A new challenger approaches...[/h1]
One thing's for sure: we're not done adding new teams to the game! We have plenty of prototypes in the works, and some are already getting their artwork done as we speak. This upcoming team? Definitely a sellout!
[quote=author][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/b970a260b6a945d521480263fc22a327c19d2c30.png[/img][/quote]
We hope you're excited for the next patch, which will kick off the experimental branch testing phase! As always, we truly appreciate your feedback.[url=https://discord.gg/2fbDGEGpH2] Feel free to join our Discord community to chat with us![/url]

See you soon!

[b]- The Tape To Tape Team[/b]

notes.title: GAME UPDATE - PATCH NOTES 0.1.16
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/ba93d1007682b59f8614b3de6705b0b5cb63f140.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes 0.1.16[/h1]

Patch 0.1.16 introduces a complete UI overhaul along with a variety of additions, gameplay improvements, and system enhancements. We will also go over the progression of the roadmap going into 2025 right away!

[h2][b]Roadmap[/b][/h2]
As pleased as we are with the current progression on the roadmap, we’re incredibly excited about what’s on the horizon! We’re aiming to release an alpha version of the [b]Roguelite Campaign 2.0 to our Beta Testers in early 2025[/b]. While this will still be a significant work-in-progress, we’ll make sure to incorporate all your feedback as we refine it further. We know we’ve been teasing it for a while, but soon we’ll finally be able to share it with our beloved testers!

If you haven’t already, be sure to join our Discord to get involved and test out all the exciting upcoming features!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/ca62a02ae0c7aaac83edb345cc30616b4a89ff1c.png[/img]

[h2][b]UI Rework[/b][/h2]
As we continue developing the 2.0 version of the campaign, the UI overhaul was a much-needed update. Being able to see your power-ups on each players during a game was a highly requested feature. It was designed with [b]your feedback[/b] in mind, and we still need your input! Let us know what you think about it!

[h3]The following are toggle-able options in the Settings Menu:[/h3]
[*]You may now see the team's artefacts and the power-ups of the player currently in control of the puck!
[quote=author][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/a324ddd5a0de9270093e162c1eee9963ab58efe0.png[/img][/quote][*] Skaters can now display their active power-ups above their heads!
[quote=author][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/8b89715aab0f236058a9e9a6dfd097b2895c3b44.gif[/img][/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/c601c1c231af1149ceedb1f60847a39ebc575b5c.png[/img]
[*] Team Customization now features the newly revamped UI
[*] You can now rotate your skater during Skater Customization to get a full 360° view of your creation
[quote=author][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/5ac032591a8b586b18d80dcf26490a87b337604d.png[/img][/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/a7f368657e241551a9caca270e8e7a7b22c9ed29.png[/img]
[*]New UI Animations for Tournament Menu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/1158ee5a0339f538c5a88d0efea673d9f1ff3493.png[/img]
[list][*] Improvements to pass direction calculation and pass reception
[*] Enhanced goalie rebound mechanics
[*] Goalies will butterfly more frequently during breakaways
[*] Adjusted checking formula: vulnerability and size differences no longer always guarantee a successful hit
[*] AI now occasionally misses their body checks
[*] Removed the "Swap to Goalie" function. Players can only control the goalie when position-locked or if the goalie has possession of the puck[/list][quote=author][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/4a95c180550add2da13efc170ee8c767a0d6a284.gif[/img][/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/418b4e28ad7148ccc776ad09fa3618b83834abf2.png[/img]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where you'd lose control of a position-locked goalie at the end of a period
[*] Setting a locked position away from the skater with the puck no longer incorrectly shows your player color above them
[*] Fixed an issue with goal replays
[*] Tentative fix for one-timer sound sometimes playing too soon
[*] Fixed an issue with animation mixing during faceoffs[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/f199ccde7f34b863d76c1a6718d7c9cca36ab477.png[/img]
[*] New Camera Settings: Alternating, Always Up, Always Down
[*] Underlying changes to how sprites are split up, which will pave the way for even more customization options in the future! Stay tuned for exciting new features down the line.
[quote=author][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/120d5342fcc963889d35e6af0cfd33766952319f.png[/img][/quote]
[h2][b]Final Notes[/b][/h2]
And that wraps up our final Patch Notes of 2024! There’s so much ahead in 2025, and we’re buzzing with excitement about what’s to come. A huge thank you to everyone for your continued love and support. We absolutely love reading your reviews and feedback and interacting with our amazing community.

From all of us here at Excellent Rectangle, we want to wish you and your families a Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays, and a Happy New Year!

[b]The Tape to Tape Team[/b]

notes.title: GAME UPDATE - PATCH NOTES 0.1.15
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/1e97e15b4fedda293990bdea6a0b3c43a1361d29.png[/img]

[list][h1]Patch Notes 0.1.15 [/h1]

From exciting new power-ups and relics to the addition of a new Elite Team, the highly requested Tournament Mode, and a host of gameplay changes - Welcome to Patch Notes 0.1.15! This update is packed with fresh content and improvements. Let's dive right in!

[i]Please note that all the features below are not final. Your feedback is always appreciated to help us continue improving every aspect of the game![/i][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/df18582007f0987c671211d1d3ab6ae2d0511f13.png[/img]
[list][h1][b]The Shooting Stars are taking over Act 3![/b][/h1]

Introducing the newest alternate Elite team addition: the [b]Shooting Stars[/b]! Masters of skating, crafty at eluding physical contact, and—of course—beautiful, magnificent, and good-smelling! Salchow Bob and his friend will surely bring their A-game as they guard your path to the Golfers. Don’t hold onto that puck for too long, because Timmy Spinelli is never far behind, ready to send you… spinning! Be wary of all that glitters…[/list]

notes.title: GAME UPDATE - PATCH NOTES 0.1.14
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/5d22810b3621606dc821c0ec8e262599a0895e0e.png[/img] 

[list][h3]What's good, everyone! Here are the Patch Notes for 0.1.14![/h3]

For this month's update, we’ve got [b]a lot[/b] to unpack!

First and foremost, we’ve listened to your feedback—Butcher needed some training. We’ve reworked many goaltender fundamentals, adding new animations, behaviors, and AI improvements!

We’re also excited to introduce the Alpha version of manual goalies for you to try out and provide feedback on, along with the Beta version of the Shootout Mode!

Lastly, for those who enjoy the Play Now mode, we’ve added 32 new basic teams to play with!

[b]But wait... there’s more![/b]

[i]Please note that all the features below are not final. Your feedback is always appreciated to help us continue improving every aspect of the game![/i][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/1994e79da6c6e44a8ef1c52c9819e86f3848cfdb.png[/img]
[list]The goalies' AI and physics have been improved in this patch with new animations, movements, and AI tweaks! We've received a lot of feedback lately regarding instances where goalies would allow frustrating goals, be out of position, or not behave properly. We're not giving up on you—here's what's new with goalies this patch![/list]
[list][*] Shot calculation, reaction, positioning, rebound, and recovery control reworked
[quote=author] Goalies now have better reactions to all types of shots and will recover more effectively to rebounds based on where the puck lands[/quote][*] New goalie animations added, and existing animations polished
[quote=author][i]New short blocker and glove saves added for when the puck is closer to the body in both standing and butterfly stances. Existing goalie animations have also been polished for better look and performance.[/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/ad001484c3df2b8f4e6bdec392f106e9a6210854.gif[/img][/quote][*] Standing and butterfly gobble animations added for long and weak shots
[quote=author][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/1a31d7a8af1fdbc84269c61609995ac0467f8e5f.gif[/img][/quote][*] New animations in butterfly state 
[quote=author][i]Goalies can now butterfly push side to side to better position themselves when the puck is closer. This also improves their effectiveness in handling rebounds and recovering from them.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/b06433e576ccfc7aa972d2418f0883fa93692583.gif[/img][/quote][*] Goalies will now fetch the puck in the corners if there is no pressure
[*] Improved butterfly-to-standing animations for smoother transitions
[*] Blocker saves now launch the puck into the air more frequently, with improved rebound redirection.
[*] Puck handling animation improvements[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/48e43d3c0351c4ab36f20018b84c3ba91e06c2e5.png[/img][list]
The alpha version of [b]manual goalies[/b] is finally here! Certainly, anyone opting for the manual goalie will be better than Butcher... [b]RIGHT[/b]? That said, as this is a work-in-progress, certain features are still missing. [b]Not all AI-controlled goalie saves are available at this time.[/b] A locked camera feature is also on the way for future patches to manual goalies. Your feedback is vital to us to ensure we keep progressing in the right direction!

[*] Now available in Campaign, Play Now & Shootout mode
[quote=author]Switch to the goalie with LB+A (L1+X on PS controllers, R+Up Arrow on Keyboard). You will remain as the goalie until you press the combo again.[/quote][*] Controls are available for remapping in the Controls Customization menu under Options.
[*] Available movement/saves at this time[quote=author]Left+Right Pad save, blocker & glove
Left+Right pad to drop into Butterfly - release to stand back up[/quote]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/039ec7c921daff5acfd95ade813e6ec479906b8e.png[/img]
[list]The time has come to test your skills in our new [b]Shootout Mode[/b]!
Start a shootout match from the Practice Menu. You can choose teams, the number of rounds, power-ups (ON/OFF), and manual goalies (ON/OFF).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/420a5841ae8e6375c7a7bec949621a28805e9497.gif[/img][i]Remember: Use backwards skating and puck flipping to your advantage!
[/i][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/1158ee5a0339f538c5a88d0efea673d9f1ff3493.png[/img][list]
[*] Improved AI on Defense
[quote=author][i]There were many instances where the AI was mispositioned on defense, and this has been addressed. The AI will now spread out and position properly, creating different shot and play opportunities when entering the offensive zone. This feature is still in development, and we will monitor feedback to continue improving it.[/i][/quote][*] Improved AI on Offense
[quote=author][i]Previous updates encouraged the AI on offense to take more lower-quality shots, reducing automatic scoring on [i]nearly[/i] every shot. While we’ve seen improvement, we’ve made additional tweaks to their shooting patterns, playmaking, and behaviors when entering the offensive zone. This feature is still in development, and we will continue to monitor feedback to keep improving it.[/i][/quote][*] The Princesses
[quote=author][i]The ultimate gatekeeper of Act 3 has received a small nerf. We understand they had an overwhelming set of tools to keep you from reaching the Golfers. With that said, Joan Ozark and Clementine McShaggy have had their abilities removed. But don't take anything for granted—you’re still one fart away from losing the game![/i][/quote][*] Added 32 new teams based on professional hockey league cities
[quote=author][i]Due to popular demand, we've added our own humorous twist to the missing professional team logos and included them in the customizer for you to enjoy! Shoutout to our community member Lastlight for his original work creating the teams and players![/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/c4018a34d62c0b4aac6a0594c8f3f4e1aa19c759.png[/img][/quote][*] New UI/effect for better puck visibility when it is occluded behind the boards
[*] Camera improvements when following the puck
[*] Added the following new VFXs (Many more are on the way!)
[quote=author][i]Magnet Vortex[/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/2be7e4da9c4078f14db3e1930109bdc564cdb589.gif[/img][/quote][quote=author][i]Dance[/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/0c773f915896427698f742ba25ab3ea8f75e8c1a.gif[/img][/quote][quote=author][i]Puck impacts and goalie saves impacts on different surfaces: boards, goal posts and Knights goalie blocker[/i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/161d9a44b20e0ba8662127955c2fab02ddd520c5.gif[/img][/quote][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/c601c1c231af1149ceedb1f60847a39ebc575b5c.png[/img]
[list][*] Removed duplicate faces in the customizer
[*] Added the following talents to Skater customization
[quote=author]Defensive Deflect
Divine Passes
Iron Helmet
Marauder
Rebound Magnet[/quote][*] Customizer menus now sorted alphabetically
[*] Added the 32 new logos in the customizer
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/f199ccde7f34b863d76c1a6718d7c9cca36ab477.png[/img]

[list][*] Fixed game resolution issues which were being triggered by alt-tabbing or pressing alt+enter
[*] Added control rebinds for manual goalies[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/418b4e28ad7148ccc776ad09fa3618b83834abf2.png[/img][list]
[*] Unlockable Characters no longer consist of yellow squares
[i]Or a collection of Pokemon badges...[/i]
[*] Spamming Skip Replay no longer causes extra screen wipes on the next face-off
[*] Goalies' faces no longer appear scrambled inside their helmets during certain animations
[*] Fixed visual bugs with players' helmets
[*] Fixed a bug where the player's logos would disappear on certain animations or transitions
[*] Fixed a bug where you could not select a post-game reward
[*] Fixed a bug causing intermittent game crashes after the national anthem when you have the Referee Rumble power-up
[*] Fixed broken glass particles so they now collide with the floor instead of passing through it
[*] Fixed a bug in practice mode where players could control the puck without possessing it[/list]

Finally, here is the updated roadmap to give you a glimpse of the progress we've made since the last update. Console porting is progressing well and we can't wait to show you more of the revamped roguelite campaign...starting with some brand new teams in the near future. 

Hope you guys enjoy!

notes.title: GAME UPDATE - PATCH NOTES 0.1.11
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone! Happy New Year![/h2]

[b]Patch 0.1.11 brings several changes to bodychecks, pokechecking, animations, and bug fixes![/b]
[i]Scroll down for answers to frequently asked questions, what's next, and a [b]teaser[/b]![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/93e6c6b6694b24178fedfb1e923a7308b4fd1205.png[/img]

[h3][u]Gameplay Changes[/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] Pokechecking Reworks
[quote=author] Pokechecking was a feature that felt non-existent for the longest time, primarily because there was no visual feedback. Now, when engaging in a stick-to-stick battle with the opposing puck carrier, an animation will trigger. Pokechecking proves to be a solid tool, especially when facing a larger opponent that you can't bodycheck. It's worth noting that the pokechecking range decreases with higher game difficulty, but it is now more accurate than before!

Additionally, changes were made to the puck when a player is pokechecked. The puck will flip a little higher, making it easier for takeaways. [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/8ba4fab3db299634db15ee22375fe3b2a8926968.gif[/img]

[*] Bodychecking Formula Reworks
[quote=author] [i]Ever stacked up the absolute Terminator with over 100 bodychecking stat and still got staggered or knocked down by the smallest player going at 1MPH?[/i] 
[b]Not anymore![/b] We've tweaked the bodychecking formula to better determine when a player gets staggered or knocked down by a bodycheck.

Remember, your skating speed before delivering a bodycheck is crucial. However, if a player has a significantly lower bodychecking stat than their opponent, different results may occur based on the skating speed before the hit. If the speed and checking stat of an opponent are weaker, chances are your Terminator won't even get staggered! On the flip side, a player with a heavy bodychecking stat AND speed will crush those smaller players!"

It's a work in progress, and we'll certainly consider all feedback to make further adjustments! [/quote]
[*] Players bodychecked along the boards will no longer clip through it

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/adafcb66486f240f94c7c01a0e2da5982f238d11.gif[/img]

[*] Turning and Shooting animations are now smoother
[quote=author] Turning, pivoting to backward skating, and shooting animations are now more crisp, providing better overall feedback. [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/56b19874c37e183f917fd650e9a89fffa0469b10.gif[/img][*] Blockshot colliders increased
[*] Greasy Lettuce & Golfers' goalies butterfly speed slightly nerfed
[*] Minor AI changes
[/list]
[u][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a one-timer pass would go much faster than expected
[*] Fixed a bug where changing your players' positions (Line-up menu) while in-game would cause a bug in their positions during faceoffs
[*] Fixed a bug where settings would not carry over after the next time the game is launched
[*] Minor visual fixes to jerseys and helmets
[*] Fixed a bug where Golfers' bench players would have no bodies
[*] Tentative fix where the referee would not drop the puck on faceoffs
[/list]

[b][u]Known Issues[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Customization feature may cause crashes and could be nonfunctional for Steam Deck users due to being manageable with keyboard and mouse only, we apologize for the inconvenience and will resolve the issue as soon as possible.
[*] Minor visual bugs with players' numbers and names
[*] Visual issue with celebrations (notably hand disappearing when doing the "Jagr salute")
[*] Graphical issue with players' scoring banners wearing an extra helmet or misplaced helmet
[*] Minor texture issues
[/list]

[u][h2]What's Next!?[/h2][/u]
We have talked quite a bit about the [b]Roguelite Campaign rework[/b] and that is our next step. This includes a lot of reworks and changes which includes:
[list]
[*] Better progression system
[*] Better gameplay loop
[*] More Elite teams
[*] Alternate Bosses [i](More information below)[/i]
[*] Different ways to acquire power-ups & trainings
[*] Ability to upgrade your goaltender throughout your runs [i](Goodbye bad Butcher)[/i]
[*] MORE Power-ups
[*] MORE Relics
[/list]
And much more that we will cover in future posts!

[b]If you would like to be part of the testing team for the future updates and the campaign rework, make sure to [url=https://discord.gg/tapetotape]JOIN OUR DISCORD![/url][/b]

[quote=author]We currently have prototypes for four Elite and Boss teams that we're actively working on. We're excited to introduce a breath of fresh air to the existing pool of teams in the game! Speaking of alternate bosses, here's a [b]preview of our first [i](and almost ready to ship)[/i] alternate boss![/b][/quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250360/57f9ad702390219cf5e3fa598a6fdaee13ff891e.gif[/img]

[u][h3]FAQ (Discord & Community Hub)[/h3][/u]
[b]Will we be able to use our own customized team for the campaign?[/b]
[quote=author]It's very likely, as we love the idea of bringing your own squad for a challenge. This may be included in the campaign rework.[/quote]
[b]Will there be more AI strategies (Defensive & Offensive)[/b]
[quote=author] Absolutely! We're eager to expand the team archetypes you can build throughout your runs and delve deeper into AI behavior! [/quote]
[b]Will there be more challenges other than first to score a goal against the Spartans?[/b]
[quote=author] We are definitely exploring more variants of challenges that feel both challenging and rewarding.[/quote]

notes.title: Developer Update & Patch Notes 0.1.6
notes.content:
Howdy!

We hope you had a great summer season! 

[b]First and foremost[/b], we want to express our heartfelt appreciation for your patience over these past few months.

We recognize that it's been quite a wait, and we can't thank you enough for sticking with us. We sincerely apologize for the lack of updates and communication. [b]You deserve better from the Tape to Tape team[/b].

We won't delve too much into the personal issues causing the delay, but rest assured, it was a combination of life events and some foundational challenges with the game's structure that we had to address. To move forward with Tape to Tape, we realized it was necessary to take a step back, reevaluate our approach, and rework the game's underlying systems.

[b]The good news?[/b] We had a long list of technical issues with the game that were holding us back from adding more content. The structure itself was so limited that nothing more could be added. Now, we're happy to announce that this will no longer be an issue. This has also allowed us to start working on the [b]Customization feature[/b], among many other exciting things. Keep an eye out for that!

[b]We remain as dedicated and passionate as ever about Tape to Tape[/b], and we're doubling down on our commitment to regular communication and updates. As a team, we've taken responsibility for the delay and are committed to moving forward, continuing to listen to the community as we have since day one. [b]You're a part of our journey, and we value every bit of feedback, critique, and support you bring our way.[/b]

We're back, [b]Butcher still sucks[/b].

[b]Thank you for your understanding and continued support.[/b]

Oh and, we’re working on offsides as a toggle-able rule and it's soon to hit the beta branch, join our Discord if you are interested in testing: [url=https://discord.gg/tapetotape]TTT Discord[/url]


[b]Now with the Patch Notes![/b]

[h1]Patch 0.1.6
[/h1]

[b]Dev notes:[/b]
As much as this may appear to be a lengthy list, it primarily focuses on addressing small bug fixes and tweaks. However, significant work was done to improve the [b]GOALIES and AI[/b]! Investing time and work into both, particularly goalies, was crucial. Our goal is to ensure that when we introduce goalie power-ups, we have the best possible goalie AI infrastructure in place. This will give goalies their own unique identity, making each one feel distinct from the others. It should also bring us peace by slowly killing the inconsistent goaltending in the game.

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b]Goaltender rework[/b]
[*]Improvements to shot quality calculation
[*]New animations 
[*]Improved timings and slides
[*]More aggressive at fetching the puck from up close
[*]Added a mega rebound ability for goaltenders, Dominik Cassette has it by default
[*]Goaltenders will now pass the puck on a random timer before the whistle (used to be at every .5 seconds - this should create more fluidity in the goalie’s AI passing)
[*]Currently working on an internal goalie attribute system ([i]More to come[/i])

[b]General[/b]
[*]AI improvements (general behavior, shooting and, movement (dodging players when in control of the puck)
[*]Improved player selection algorithm
[*]Kazoo ability now has a longer cooldown
[*]Headshot redirect ability improvements & bug fixes (It will now be effective from any angles as per before was not working consistently when shooting from specific angles)
[*]Puck puncher ability will now only work in the offensive zone (also fixed an issue where the ability was not firing a wrist shot properly)
[*]Fixed an issue where the puck would automatically get batted in the goal after a rebound (Instead of letting the rebound happen)
[*]Reduced the time on braking which should translate in smoother directional transitions
[*]AIs on your team will now bodycheck if you are player locked
[*]Your AI teammates in the Campaign mode on Easy difficulty will now bodycheck
[*]Tentative fix to remove hats on the ice where they would remain on the ice after a hat trick
[*]Reduced velocity on sticks when interacting with the Fart or Magnet ability
[*]Cooldown on abilities are no longer recharging between game stoppages
[*]Shot accuracy reworked - Less accurate from closed angles, slapshots and one-timers (Shot accuracy will now be most valuable to invest on)
[*]The puck will no longer conserve its original speed (according to the shot power of the shooter) when getting tipped, batted or when using the Headshot Redirect ability
[*]Spin-o-rama ability is slower and will rotate the player in the proper direction according to the stick handedness
[*]Skaters' AIs will no longer stay stuck skating into the boards
[*]Fixed a bug where a goal would not be denied after skipping a replay (ie: Using the briefcase)
[*]Fixed a bug where post game rewards could be duplicated and applied to multiple players
[*]Fixed a bug related to the Weighted Die relic and re-rolling power-ups
[*]Fixed a bug where power-ups with gain +X on wins would not be rewarded after defeating bosses
[*]Scroll bar added for the abilities in the lineup menu
[*]Fixed a bug where the anthem would keep playing after quitting a game
[*]Fixed a bug where the anthem would keep playing after the initial puck drop
[*]Various audio sound balancing fixes & bugs
[*]End of run stats are now available with a proper UI
[/list]

[h3][b]System[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Major rework to the core infrastructure which should resolve memory issues opening the door to a lot of future updates[/b]
[*]Borderless window option added
[*]Tentative fix for player locking and other related bugs
[*]Tentative fix addressed for duplicated controllers in the controller selection menu
[*]Tentative fix where the difficulty selector screen would pop up in the Campaign’s menu while playing via Steam Remote Play
[/list]

[*]Small tweaks on goalie passes

notes.content:
Hey everyone, this is the second Early Access Patch Notes!

As usual, thank you so much for helping us report bugs and providing your feedback!

Before we jump into the patch notes, we would like to address a few concerns that we have read about lately. We understand that there are a few things in the roguelite campaign that definitely need to be balanced/reworked. Know that all the feedback has been heard, and we are also working towards our first content/rework patch. Being a small team, we are primarily focusing on fixing the small bugs and tweaking some aspects of the game before launching  new content/rework patches. We have quite a bit in store, and we are excited to release them as soon as we can!

We are currently working on a Wiki to provide all the information about Tape to Tape. We will pin the link to the wiki on our community hub as soon as it's completed. However, if you are interested in helping the team, [url=https://discord.gg/tapetotape]join our Discord[/url] and message Hastan#0789! We are looking for players with experience in building a Wiki!

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list][*]The High Flyer relic has been updated so that passes are now much higher, which should feel more noticeable and proper

[*]Random Events - Angus' metamorphosis events (Baskangus, Moongus, Monkgus, etc.) are more likely to appear, while events such as Price of Power, Puck Scientist, etc. should be offered less frequently. We are also looking into reworking some events to provide a better gameplay experience

[*]Goalie passes have been reworked and will now properly target the pass receiver ([i]Billy Butcher now has a yearly membership at the gym[/i])

[*]The Cultists’ greasy sticks received a slight nerf, but it wasn't [i]completely removed[/i]. Instead, you will [b]only[/b] lose your stick on Slapshots.

[*]The Cherrypicker talent now roams around the blue line, whereas previously the player was too far into the opposing zone

[*][b]Player hitboxes increased[/b] - bodychecks should be easier and less frustrating to land ([i]We will continue monitoring feedback to make sure the tuning is appropriate[/i])

[*]Fixed an issue where a hit would not properly register in some instances ([i]ie: Prince Tristan sometimes became invulnerable. Time to give him some good shoulder hits now![/i])

[*]The boss mercy rule has been properly set to 6. With the exception of the Act 3 boss. ([i]It was mentioned in the previous patch to be 6 but was not applied correctly[/i])

[*]Tentative fix where a goal could be scored from behind the net

[*]AI is now less likely to turn around in a breakaway situation or in a 2v0 instead of shooting at the net

[*]Campfire: Resting now gives +3 OVR ([i]+3 to all attributes[/i]) instead of +4.[/list]

[h3]UI, Menus, General Fixes[/h3]

notes.title: Update - Patch Notes 0.1.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First of all, thank you so much for all the reviews, feedback, and ideas that you sent to us through the Reviews, Community Hub & our Discord community server! We are overwhelmed by your drive to help us polish the game during the Early Access period! We really appreciate your time!

[b]Let's jump into those patch notes![/b]

[h2]PATCH NOTES 0.1.2[/h2]

[h3][b]UI, Menu & Misc.[/b][/h3]

[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Prince's charge shot sound would continue to play even after the game had ended.
[*]Fixed an issue with the recognition of the controller layout button on the Blademaster's confirmation screen after purchasing a new skill or superstar
[*]Fixed a minor navigation bug that was affecting the main menu and settings
[*]Added a minor delay after playing a game to prevent accidentally choosing a reward if you are quickly mashing the confirm button (you know who you are, we got you!).
[*]Fixed the button prompt for cancelling a goal when you have the Briefcase relic, so that it matches your controller's button layout correctly
[*]Added a pop-up on the game launch advising of the Early Access period
[*]Fixed the color of the jersey worn by your goaltender when playing against the Meatballs (campaign)
[*]Replays can now be skipped by pressing Enter when playing with a keyboard
[*]Fixed a bug with previous demo saves unlocking everything in the Blademaster's shop on the Early Access Launch Version.
[*]Fixed an issue with the gamepad being duplicated.[/list]

[h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3]

[list][*]Increased the number of rubbers won, which should help with the player's progression. (We will closely monitor feedback to ensure that this change is balanced fairly.)
[*]The Greasy Lettuce (Act 1 Elite Team) now has less pass propel force, which significantly slows down their skating speed when receiving a pass.
[*]Willie Brie, Cam Amber, and Chloe Crocket are now automatically unlocked in the shop as starters
Spinorama, Tomahawk, and Dash active abilities are now automatically unlocked and bought in the shop as starters
[*]The Megalob active skill has been temporarily removed from the shop and will become part of an event during a campaign run.
[*]Billy Butcher (Calaveras' goaltender) has been buffed in Casual and Normal difficulty levels of the campaign. ([i]He offers his sincere apologies for the inconsistent goaltending as of late[/i])
[*]AI’s pokecheck and pass interception range has been slightly reduced on Standard difficulty
[*]Added a mercy rule for bosses that triggers when there is a 5-goal differential [i][b](Disabled against the final boss)[/b][/i]
[*]Fixed an out-of-bounds issue that occurred when controlling the puck near the boards with an extra large player (ie: Sergei Lancelov)
[*]The Zebras' shot accuracy has been slightly nerfed as they felt a little too unfair at times.
[*]AI's last-second shot attempts are less accurate.
[*]Fixed an issue with the final boss of Act 3 on a second playthrough where the game softlocks. We are also looking into other instances of softlocks and will update you guys as soon as possible.[/list]

[b]List of known [b]notable[/b] bugs,issues and feedback we will be working on next:[/b]
- Volume sliders resetting between games
- Players looking for their stick when it goes out of bounds leaving them skating into the boards until the next whistle
- General AI tuning behaviours in both offense and defense [In the works! We know it can be frustrating!]
- General balancing of the campaign's difficulty at all levels
- Goals being scored from behind the net as a result of a glitch
- Decreasing the time between transitions, in and outside the of the game
- Faster replay skipping


[h3]In other news[/h3]

We are looking to increase our pool of Testers that are willing to test out new features, find bugs and providing feedback on future content and balance patches during the Early Access Period of Tape to Tape! If you are interested, we invite you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/tapetotape]Discord Server[/url]!
